history.summary: Freehold, well-built 2017 D15 luxury condo with TE25 Tanjong Katong MRT literally at the doorstep (80m) and a standout 10.3%/yr URA resale CAGR. This 3BR at PSF 2171 is a striking ~10% discount to the project median of 2411; the offsets are a high $2.64M quantum, a small 109-unit boutique base, and a thin 32-txn sample. A high-confidence Buy on location and value.
history.rating_rationale: The location is exceptional: 80m to TE25 (Thomson-East Coast Line direct to CBD/Marina Bay), freehold, established East Coast D15 lifestyle, completed 2017 with positive build-quality reviews. The 10.3%/yr resale CAGR is the highest non-Punggol figure in the batch, and PSF 2171 vs URA median 2411 is a clear ~10% discount — buying below where the project transacts. Tenure (FH) and doorstep MRT give deep long-run liquidity despite the $2.64M quantum. Risks are real but secondary: only 109 units (boutique, thinner same-project comps) and just 32 URA txns lower data confidence, and $2.64M is above the deepest buyer band. On balance the location/tenure/discount stack outweighs them.
red_flags: Small 109-unit boutique development — fewer comparable resale transactions
Thin 32-txn URA sample lowers appreciation-rate confidence

catalysts: TE25 Tanjong Katong MRT 80m away — full Thomson-East Coast Line connectivity
Freehold tenure in a perennially-demanded D15 East Coast location
PSF ~10% below project median offers value entry; 10.3%/yr resale CAGR
